period_note: Standalone (solo) basis, from the bank's own 'Condensed Balance Sheet (Unaudited)'/'Condensed Profit and Loss Account (Unaudited)' (distinct from the 'Condensed Consolidated' statements printed earlier in the same filing). Matches the basis of this bank's own 2021-2025 Q4/annual series (solo). Income-statement items use the 'Cumulative Jan to Sep 2021' column; the filing also separately discloses a discrete 'Quarter ended Jul to Sep 2021' column (interest income 5,256,495,480; PAT 1,378,075,866; EPS 0.99) not recorded here. Balance sheet identity reconciles to within BDT 1 million (rounding): 390,896m assets vs 343,452m liabilities + 47,443m equity = 390,895m. Every P&L subtotal reconciles exactly.
